name: load-regulation
description: Load regulation across the ratified 1-50 mA window via a single in-run .dc sweep
claim: README.md Target specification, 'Load reg (0-50 mA)' row: < 1% (18 mV), counted inside the +/-2% accuracy window rather than in addition to it. Measured 1 mA -> 50 mA (the divider's own ~2 uA preload plus a light 1 mA is used as the low end, per DR-0001's minimum-load statement folded into the ratified Load row).

operating_conditions.load_current: 1 mA -> 50 mA, single .dc sweep (2 endpoints) per PVT point
operating_conditions.enable_state: enabled (EN tied to VIN at instantiation)

load_reg_mv.description: README.md Load reg (0-50 mA) target: < 1% = 18 mV around the 1.8 V nominal output
